Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Declares forty producing families in the city of Corrientes, with the cooperative's landline.

Own page of the cooperative of agroecological workers of the city of Corrientes; growing without agrochemicals and selling at neighbourhood fairs. Page reachable only through search indexing: Facebook blocks this environment's address.

notes: The map misspells the name as 'Cooperativa agoecologica Yvy Maraney'; the cooperative's own page writes it Cooperativa Agroecológica Yvy Maraney.
